name: Komatsu Shoko
source: As the auditing committee chairman, she is responsible for ensuring that all student-related affairs proceed according to the rules. Although she takes her job seriously and is committed to her role, she also does not want anyone to hate her for it. Tends to be forced into troublesome situations, but is also the type to pull through when it really matters.
